usage.title: How it works
usage.description: From prompt to image to video in three simple steps:

items.title: Write a clear prompt
items.description: Describe subject, style, motion, and any text you need — one prompt can drive both image and video output.

items.title: Pick an image or video model
items.description: Choose a video model such as Seedance 2.5 or Veo 3.1, or an image model such as Seedream 4.0, for the output you need.

items.title: Generate, then go image to video
items.description: Start from text or a reference image, then turn the still into video motion without leaving the studio.

items.title: Refine locally until it ships
items.description: Re-run just the part you want to change — retext, restyle, or re-compose — instead of regenerating from scratch.

features.title: Built for real creative workflows
features.description: Everything you need for modern image generation, editing, and video creation in one studio.

items.title: High-Quality Generation and Editing
items.description: Oddbeam is designed for both generating new images and editing existing ones, making it suitable for end-to-end creative workflows.

items.title: Reference Image Fidelity
items.description: Upload reference images to preserve style, subject details, product structure, or brand elements with better consistency during image-to-image editing.

items.title: Text Rendering and Transparent Backgrounds
items.description: Well-suited for posters, social graphics, stickers, and product assets that need text in image or transparent background output.

items.title: Flexible Sizes and Commercial Visuals
items.description: Supports a range of image sizes and practical workflows for ecommerce, marketing creatives, social content, and branded image production.

items.title: Quality-First Output
items.description: Optimized for image quality rather than ultra-low latency, so complex generations may take longer but are better suited for polished final visuals.

items.question: What is Oddbeam?
items.answer: Oddbeam is an all-in-one AI studio for image and video creation. You can generate images from prompts, animate them into video, and edit both in a single workflow, with models like Seedance, Seedream, Veo, Wan, Kling, Nano Banana, Flux and Grok available in one place.

items.question: What can Oddbeam do well?
items.answer: It covers text-to-image generation, image-to-image editing, image-to-video animation, reference-driven restyling, text rendering inside images, transparent background outputs, and commercial creative production.

items.question: Why is Oddbeam different from single-model tools?
items.answer: Instead of locking you into one model, Oddbeam brings multiple image and video models into one workflow, so you can pick the right model for each task without switching between separate tools.

items.question: Can I upload images and edit them?
items.answer: Yes. Oddbeam supports image editing workflows, so you can upload one or more reference images, guide changes with detailed instructions, and then animate the result into video.

items.question: Does Oddbeam support text in image and transparent backgrounds?
items.answer: Yes. Several supported models handle text rendering and transparent background output, which is especially useful for social graphics, product assets, logos, and sticker-like outputs.

items.question: Is Oddbeam optimized for speed?
items.answer: Quality comes first. Complex prompts or detailed edits can take longer, but the platform is positioned for higher-quality generation and editing rather than minimum latency.

items.question: Can Oddbeam generate NSFW or explicit content?
items.answer: No. Oddbeam strictly prohibits generating any NSFW, pornographic, explicit, or harmful content. All requests are automatically reviewed under our safety policies and model provider usage guidelines. Attempts to generate prohibited content will be rejected, and repeated violations may result in account suspension. We are committed to maintaining a safe and responsible platform for all users.

video_items.question: How does AI video generation work here?
video_items.answer: Enter a text prompt for text-to-video, or upload reference frames for image-to-video. Pick a model, aspect ratio, and duration, then generate — the result appears in the preview area and in your works library.

video_items.question: Which video models are supported?
video_items.answer: You can generate videos with models such as Veo 3.1 (Premium/Lite), Kling 2.1, Seedance, Gemini, Pixverse, and MiniMax. Each model supports different durations, resolutions, and reference-image capabilities.

video_items.question: How are video credits calculated?
video_items.answer: Credits depend on the model, duration, and resolution you choose. The exact credit cost is shown next to the generate button before you submit, so there are no surprises.

video_items.question: Can I use a reference image to control the video?
video_items.answer: Yes. Models that support image-to-video accept one or more reference images (some also support first and last frames), and the generated video follows the composition and motion cues of your input.
